Description
The Analytic Developer designs, creates and implements automated data visualizations and extracts in order to achieve product functionalities and meet business needs. Under close supervision, this position supports and participates in the coding, debugging, testing, and configuration work streams that guide the development of analytic solutions. All work performed should be in accordance with enterprise standards and problems faced are not typically difficult or complex.

Essential Job Function:

Reviews functional and technical requirements in order to assist in creating specifications for analytic solution development.
Utilizes data programming, business intelligence development, and data visualization activities to maintain and produce basic analytic solutions with oversight.
Performs unit testing of analytic solutions to help ensure accuracy, effective processing, and a positive user experience.
Supports internal analytic solution technical documentation.
Assists generally in the implementation, enhancement, integration, and maintenance of analytic solutions.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Education:

Required: Bachelor's Degree.

Experience:

Required: 0-2 years
